title: GIAB WES parameters
description: Strict nonclinical foundation and synthetic M3 shared-preprocessing parameters. Canonical execution remains gated.

input_output_options.title: Input/output options

outdir.description: Directory for copied stable workflow outputs.

workflow_mode.description: Select explicit foundation or synthetic M3 workflow; canonical mode is fail-closed until approved inputs and gates exist.

reference_options.title: Reference options
reference_options.description: Reference options for the M1 foundation contract.

reference.description: Exact reference FASTA; M3 synthetic mode binds invented reference bytes to its fixture manifest.

known_sites.description: Independent BQSR known-sites VCF; synthetic qualification requires invented fixture bytes. Benchmark truth is forbidden.

target_options.title: Target options
target_options.description: Target options for the M1 foundation contract.

targets.description: Future audited assay-target BED path; unset in M1.

preprocessing_options.title: Preprocessing options

retain_oq.description: Required original-quality retention through BQSR; false is rejected in M3.

m3_fixture_manifest.description: Deterministic invented fixture manifest with exact FASTQ/reference/known-sites identities and expected invariants.

m3_qc_window.description: Fixed target-independent coverage windows in reference bases; never an assay evaluation domain.

caller_options.title: Caller options
caller_options.description: Caller options for the M1 foundation contract.

callers.description: Planned caller-selection contract; M1 invokes no caller.

truth_vcf.description: Future GIAB truth VCF path; forbidden from caller inputs.
